basic_info.description: Showcased by two walls of glass, 12-foot ceilings & 2 terraces measuring +/-600sf, this onw-of-a-kind condo enjoys bountiful natural light in all rooms. The open kitchen, dining & living areas enjoy sun from dawn until dusk. The glass-sided southern terrace is accessed from a sliding door, & the western terrace is accessed by the kitchen & each bedroom. Additional amenities include power-operated shades, central air-conditioning, ultra-luxe bath/kitchen fixtures & materials, majestic stone installations, & in-home laundry. The Pacific is Pacific Heights' only full service, fully-amenitized newer development. The building's sought-after amenities include a grand lobby with 24-hour attendants, a residential staff of doormen, concierge, porters, engineers, & custodians. Other building highlights include a state-of-the-art fitness studio, a penthouse library & terrace, central gardens, guest suite, garage parking with direct access elevator, & bicycle storage. Steps away are the coffee houses, bistros, bookstores, & boutiques of the Fillmore Corridor and the beautiful neighborhood Alta Plaza Park.
